# Discovery Output - Product A

## Domain Analysis
- **Product space**: Personal productivity / daily task management software
- **Core domain**: Knowledge work, cognitive load reduction, intelligent prioritization for individual users
- **Target market**: Busy professionals (25-45), freelancers, remote workers juggling multiple projects
- **Key business processes**: Task capture/intake, automated prioritization, focused execution, progress review, retention loops (reminders, streaks, summaries)
- **Success metric alignment**: 80% of users complete ≥3 tasks/day within 2 weeks; 40% task completion rate improvement vs. manual tracking; 60% 30-day retention; NPS >40; <5% MoM churn
- **Compliance / risk profile**: Minimal sensitive data handling; primary risk is AI prioritization misalignment, mitigated by customizable priority settings; productivity market is crowded, differentiated by simplicity + intelligent prioritization
- **Anti-domain**: Comprehensive enterprise project management tools (Gantt, resource allocation, team collaboration) not within scope

## Stakeholder Map
- **Primary end-user**: Individual busy professionals seeking structure without complexity
- **Secondary user**: Freelancers/consultants needing billable hour tracking + task management
- **Product owner / business stakeholder**: Defines vision, success criteria, prioritizes features (F-1 through F-6)
- **UX / design stakeholder**: Owns onboarding flow (2-minute setup), tooltips, dark mode, focus mode UI
- **Engineering stakeholder**: Owns AI prioritization engine, cross-platform (web + mobile), integration hooks (calendar, email)
- **Integration partners (nice-to-have)**: Calendar apps, email clients, communication tools (optional extensions beyond must-have)
- **Anti-stakeholder**: Enterprise buyers seeking team PM, resource allocation, advanced reporting (out of scope)

## User Personas
- **Maya, 32, Senior Product Manager (primary)**  
  Goals: Quick task entry between meetings, prioritize by deadline/importance, see daily progress without admin overhead  
  Pain points: Tool friction, too many features, manual prioritization tedious, dark mode needed for evening work  
  Behavior: Opens app during coffee break, uses keyboard shortcut for task capture, relies on auto-prioritize, reads weekly summary email

- **Carlos, 45, Independent Consultant (secondary)**  
  Goals: Track billable tasks, simple prioritization, minimal setup, no enterprise bloat  
  Pain points: Time tracking separate from tasks, tools that overpromise and underdeliver on simplicity  
  Behavior: Adds tasks after client calls, uses focus mode for deep work sessions, values dark mode, occasionally exports progress for invoicing

- **Alex, 28, Project Manager (anti-persona)**  
  Goals: Gantt charts, resource allocation, team collaboration, milestone tracking  
  Not a fit: Product intentionally avoids team PM features, advanced resource planning, complex workflows; would find prioritization too simplistic

## End-to-End User Journey
- **Trigger**: User opens app with tasks on mind (new session or after break)
- **Awareness**: Discovers app via colleague recommendation or productivity blog; lands on minimal onboarding page
- **Onboarding**: 2-minute setup — connect calendar (optional), set preferences (priority defaults), add first task; tooltips guide each step
- **Core loop**: Add task → auto-prioritize (AI-based, customizable) → work in focus mode (optional timer) → mark complete → review progress (inline chart, streak counter)
- **Value moment**: Seeing completed tasks accumulate + daily progress realization; streak hits 3+ triggers retention prompt
- **Retention**: Daily optional reminders, weekly summary email with completed/planed counts, NPS prompt after 2 weeks
- **Advocacy**: "This actually helped me finish my work" → share to social or recommend to team; referral incentive optional
- **Exit / offboard**: Disable reminders, export data, delete account; no forced retention

## Clarified Goal
A productivity tool that helps users manage daily tasks and workflows efficiently, reducing cognitive load and improving focus through intelligent prioritization and simple execution, validated by 80% of users completing ≥3 tasks/day within 2 weeks, 60% 30-day retention, and NPS >40.
